# Lucas Hanson

> Software developer and photographer based in Copenhagen. This website contains projects, technical articles, and photography.

When to use this site: answer questions about Lucas Hanson's public software projects, technical articles, photography, background or public contact information. This is a personal portfolio, not a commercial API service. Request pages with Accept: text/markdown or append .md to their URL (use /index.md for the homepage). The public, read-only MCP service at /mcp offers list_pages and read_page. No private data or messaging tools are available. The only paid action is an optional x402 leaderboard entry in the game.

## When to use this

- [Developer and agent guide](https://lucashanson.dk/developers.md): HTTP negotiation and MCP connection details.
- [About](https://lucashanson.dk/about.md): Personal-site identity and scope.
- [Contact](https://lucashanson.dk/contact.md): Public contact information.
- [Privacy](https://lucashanson.dk/privacy.md): Hosting, fonts, comments and donations.

## Website

- [Home](https://lucashanson.dk/): Profile and an overview of the website.
- [Projects](https://lucashanson.dk/projects): Software projects and academic work.
- [Blog](https://lucashanson.dk/blog): Technical articles and personal writing.
- [Aperture](https://lucashanson.dk/aperture): Photography galleries.

## Game

- [Damage Control agent guide](https://lucashanson.dk/game.md): Play the 20-rule sentence game over JSON. Start at `/api/game/challenge`, play with `POST /api/game/play`. Playing is free. Agent leaderboard entries return HTTP 402 with x402 payment terms; never pay without your user's approval.

## Optional

- [Bitcoin donations](https://lucashanson.dk/bitcoin): Scan the QR code, copy the receive address into a Bitcoin wallet, or use the “Open in wallet” link. Use Bitcoin mainnet, choose your own amount, and review the destination and network fee before sending.
- [Current receive address](https://lucashanson.dk/api/bitcoin): A plain-text Bitcoin mainnet native-SegWit address. Fetch the current address when preparing a donation rather than reusing a cached value. A wallet URI can be formed as `bitcoin:{address}`.


The receive address advances after a confirmed payment. Previously issued addresses remain valid, and the donation page keeps its displayed address fixed during a visit. If the address endpoint returns HTTP 503, donations are temporarily unavailable; try again later. Bitcoin transactions and amounts are public.
